name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 4 visits over 21 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 21 hours starting 2025-05-03, at wavelengths from 0.86 to 3.45 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
